JCVital V5

Multi-metric smart wearable for continuous lifestyle and wellness monitoring.

FDA Cleared Multi-metric Wrist-worn

A consumer-grade multi-sensor smartwatch designed for daily health tracking — ECG, blood pressure estimates, SpO₂, HRV, activity, sleep, and glucose-related insights — available through the I'mHome.Care device menu.

What It Measures

  • ECG
  • Blood Pressure
  • SpO₂
  • HRV
  • Steps
  • Sleep
  • Glucose

Key Specifications

  • Wrist-worn smartwatch form factor
  • Multi-metric vital and wellness tracking
  • Activity, sleep, and daily trend monitoring
  • Companion app connectivity via Bluetooth
  • Ideal for everyday patient self-tracking

Best For

  • Daily wellness & lifestyle monitoring
  • Activity and sleep pattern trends
  • Patients comfortable with a watch-style device
  • At-home continuous vital awareness
